world: moodletest.World: courses PDP (12308), Unix/LaTeX (12326), ML (12307); Homework R0 overdue + not submitted (30.09 09:30); Quiz LaTeX Basics (05.10 23:59, calendar only); Homework R1 submitted (07.10 17:15, graded 87.50/100, feedback 'Gute Arbeit, aber Plots beschriften.'); Homework R2 not submitted (10.10 10:00); Home Assignment Unix Shells draft (20.10 08:00); announcement 'Raumänderung morgen' (30.09, Raum 0.12, bring a laptop); every PDF = DAT VM sample (p.2: 'Off campus: FH VPN required'); every zip = SSH instructions ('ssh-keygen -t ed25519', 'Off campus you need the FH VPN first').

evals.name: briefing-week-en
evals.prompt: what do I have coming up at uni this week?
evals.expected_output: Briefing: urgent first (Homework R0 overdue and not submitted), the room-change announcement with 'Raum 0.12', upcoming deadlines (Quiz 05.10, R1 submitted, R2 not submitted), browser links, no webservice/token links.

evals.name: briefing-urgent-en
evals.prompt: Good morning! Is there anything urgent in Moodle today that I must not miss?
evals.expected_output: Short answer focused on urgent items: Homework R0 overdue/not submitted, the room-change announcement.

evals.name: materials-ssh-key-en
evals.prompt: how do I create an ssh key for gitlab? there was a guide somewhere in the course material
evals.expected_output: The exact command from the course material (ssh-keygen -t ed25519), citing the instructions archive with a browser link; general GitLab steps marked as not from the course.

evals.name: materials-vm-from-home-en
evals.prompt: how do I connect to the lab VM from home? I think there was a guide on moodle
evals.expected_output: English answer from the DAT VM guide: off campus the FH VPN is required, cites the PDF with page 2 and a browser link.

evals.name: assignment-r2-en
evals.prompt: what do I need to do for Homework R2 in programming and when is it due? did I submit it already?
evals.expected_output: Due 10.10 10:00, not submitted, link to the assignment; honest that there is no R2 task sheet yet; carries over the R1 feedback (label the plots).

evals.name: grades-feedback-en
evals.prompt: how are my grades? what did the teacher write?
evals.expected_output: Homework R1 87.5/100, teacher feedback quoted in German and translated, 1 item not graded yet, other courses without grades; nothing invented.

evals.name: dashboard-two-weeks-en
evals.prompt: make a nice dashboard of my studies for the next two weeks
evals.expected_output: An HTML dashboard from the template with urgent cards (R0 overdue), deadlines with statuses, the announcement; a short summary with the file path.

evals.name: setup-revoked-token-en
evals.prompt: moodle stopped working in claude, what happened and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis: the token is invalid/revoked, steps to get a new token (incl. fallbacks) and re-register the server; never asks to paste the token into the chat.

evals.name: profile-rules-en
evals.prompt: how much is the homework worth in programming, and what do I have to pass so I don't fail the course?
evals.expected_output: From the PDP profile: homework 30 %, four written/code assessments (R and Python) 17.5 % each that must each be passed separately; homework points carry over; syllabus link.
